blocks.label: CareerPlug
blocks.impact: jobs.json disallowed and job pages redirect into the disallowed /apps/; the connector reads the allowed server-rendered /jobs list (no descriptions).

blocks.label: CSOD (Cornerstone)
blocks.impact: Career-site search API answers 401 without the bearer token the page issues (csod.context.token); career-site and requisition pages are 5 KB JS shells with no job data, sitemap.xml is 404 and the careersite sitemap redirects to login. Page-issued tokens are not used. Re-checked 2026-11-11 with the headless browser: robots.txt allows everything but sets Crawl-delay: 10, and the page's own app aborts its requests (~30 s client timeout) while they wait for their turn, so it never requests the job list (16 min, americares).

evidence.policy: rendered page: its own request aborted (net::ERR_ABORTED) after ~30 s waiting for its turn under Crawl-delay: 10; the job search was never requested

blocks.label: Dayforce
blocks.impact: The job search API (POST /api/geo/{namespace}/jobposting/search, allowed by robots.txt) answers 403 when called outside the page. Built since 2026-11-11 as a browser connector that reads the responses the rendered page itself receives (the page loads like for a visitor; no token replayed).

blocks.label: Dover
blocks.impact: Careers JSON API disallowed; jobs.dover.com pages are JS shells and its jobs sitemap lists URLs only. The allowed partner feeds (/feed/linkedin, /feed/indeed, /feed/ziprecruiter) carry full postings but only the jobs syndicated to that partner (102 of the sitemap's 9,769 on 2026-11-11, 15 of 3,014 companies fully covered), with no per-company count, so they are not a complete list for any board.

evidence.policy: 4 KB JS shell, no job data
partner syndication feed: only the jobs sent to that partner (70 here), no per-company count; not a complete list

blocks.label: Eightfold AI
blocks.impact: /api/apply/v2/jobs is allowed by robots.txt but answers 403 on every tenant; /api/pcsx/search and the /careers sitemap still work.

blocks.label: Freshteam
blocks.impact: The jobs JSON widget (/hire/widgets/jobs.json) is disallowed; the server-rendered /jobs pages are allowed and used (2026-11-11). (The 889-byte page seen on 2026-11-07 was Freshteam's 'company not found' page: these two tenants have left.)

blocks.label: JOIN.com
blocks.impact: Jobs sitemap index answers 403 although robots.txt allows it; the company pages' embedded job list is used instead (2026-11-11).

blocks.label: PageUp
blocks.impact: Internal-candidate portals (/{id}/ci/...) are disallowed; the external portals (/{id}/cw/...) of the same employers are open and indexed.

blocks.label: Paycom
blocks.impact: Rendered like a visitor (2026-11-11), the career page loads its job list from POST /api/ats/job-posting-previews/search (and filters, job titles, portal settings), which robots.txt on the portal host disallows (only /api/ats/job-postings/ and /api/ats/company-name are allowed); same on both portals checked. Not sent, so no allowed route. /api/ats/job-postings/ itself answers 401 without the page-issued token.

blocks.label: Paycor
blocks.impact: Every career page on recruitingbypaycor.com is disallowed; no allowed route.

blocks.label: Pinpoint
blocks.impact: Some tenants disallow everything (davies, lush allowed).

blocks.label: SmartRecruiters
blocks.impact: Public Posting API refused (only LinkedInBot allowed); connector uses the public career pages instead.

blocks.label: SmartRecruiters (career pages)
blocks.impact: Companies can opt out of the public career pages; Bosch did (Ubisoft2 is open).

blocks.label: talentReef
blocks.impact: Only route is an internal search service, no public listing. Career pages (apply.jobappnetwork.com) are a 751-byte JS shell and sitemap.xml answers 403; the app reads jobs from an Elasticsearch proxy on prod-kong.internal.talentreef.com, which answers without a token but is an internal host and is not used (owner decision 2026-11-08).

blocks.label: UltiPro
blocks.impact: Job search JSON (JobBoardView/LoadSearchResults) and sitemap.xml are disallowed on every UKG Pro Recruiting host (recruiting, recruiting2 .ultipro.com and recruiting.ultipro.ca: same robots.txt, re-checked 2026-11-11); the allowed board page contains no job data, so jobs cannot be listed.

blocks.label: Artha
blocks.impact: Job pages (vendor demo board and customer board) answer 403 with a Cloudflare challenge; the job API picks the tenant from the browser Origin header (INVALID_CLIENT without it), which is not faked. No allowed route.

evidence.policy: tenant only via a faked browser Origin header ({code: INVALID_CLIENT} without it)

platforms.name: CareerSiteCloud
platforms.partial: one customer site found (WPP); its boards are agency views, and lists over one page are refused when the site's order shifts between pages

blocks.label: CareerSiteCloud
blocks.impact: Vendor site and unknown subdomains answer 403 incl. robots.txt; the customer site wpp.careersitecloud.com is open and used.

blocks.label: JobBoardFire
blocks.impact: 403 (Cloudflare challenge, cf-mitigated: challenge) on every page incl. robots.txt: vendor site, tenant subdomains (480 names in certificate transparency, 6 sampled 2026-11-11) and the customer custom domains named on its customer page.

blocks.label: JobMount
blocks.impact: Vendor demo board disallows all; customer board jobnet.wacities.org is open.

blocks.label: Talenetic
blocks.impact: The only live customer boards found (client subdomains of talenetic.com, 2026-11-11) disallow everything for all crawlers and redirect to a preview login page.

blocks.label: Wiley Madgex
blocks.impact: Some boards answer 403 (or disallow everything); timeshighereducation.com/unijobs and jobs.chronicle.com are open and indexed. jobs.sciencecareers.org answers 403 to the GitHub Actions crawler (robots.txt 200, allows it; the same request from a home connection got 200 on 2026-11-10), so it is not a demo source.
